_comment: Fallback carrier tariffs used to price Montonio Shipping deliveries when the live POST /shipping-methods/rates quote (src/lib/shipping/montonio.ts, src/lib/shipping/tariffs.ts) is not configured or not reachable. Montonio itself publishes no per-carrier/country/size price list on montonio.com/pricing (that page shows dashes and gates real numbers behind a signed-in account) — see docs/shipping.md § «Тарифы Montonio» for the research trail. These rows are the carriers' own published EU business list prices, which Montonio's marketing states its contract rates match or beat («Pre-negotiated rates with top carriers»); until Renat's Montonio account has carriers activated and the live endpoint returns real per-merchant numbers, this table is used as a conservative stand-in so the shop never prices a delivery below the carrier's own list cost. Refresh with tools/fetch-montonio-tariffs.mjs.

referenceParcel.note: Matches the 'L' locker size used throughout public/shop/shipping-data.js (parcelRef) so every row here is the same nominal parcel.

rates.note: Business list, ex-VAT 4.40, computed incl. 24% VAT.
Business list, ex-VAT 8.56, computed incl. 24% VAT.
Business list, ex-VAT 9.51, computed incl. 24% VAT.
Business-prepaid list, VAT already included at source.
DPD Pickup, business list, ex-VAT 3.63, computed incl. 24% VAT.

The Finland row of the 'Muu Euroopa' table could not be aligned to its column header with full confidence on text extraction (ex-VAT 15, computed incl. VAT 18.60) — verify before quoting to a customer.

DPD Classic, up-to-10kg band, zone 4 (rest of Estonia — the priciest of 3 zones, used deliberately so no zone is billed below cost); zone 1&2 (Tallinn/Tartu and main towns) is cheaper at 8.99. ex-VAT 8.69, computed incl. 24% VAT.
Up-to-10kg band, zone 3 (priciest of 3; zone 1 / Riga is cheaper at 13.57). ex-VAT 13.13, computed incl. 24% VAT.
Up-to-10kg band, zone 3 (priciest of 3; zone 1 / Vilnius-Kaunas is cheaper at 15.56). ex-VAT 14.31, computed incl. 24% VAT.
Up-to-10kg band, no zones for FI. ex-VAT 21, computed incl. 24% VAT — same extraction caveat as the DPD FI parcel row.

notMeasured: venipak — no public price list or business PDF found; not in public/shop/shipping-data.js. Fill in once Montonio's live rates endpoint returns a number, or a Venipak price list is sourced.
unisend — same as venipak, no source at all yet.
omniva/FI — Omniva runs no parcel machines in Finland (confirmed against https://www.omniva.ee/locations.json, zero FI rows); Finland is not served by Omniva through this shop.

'EU' / 'default' rows (other European countries) — DPD's rest-of-Europe band (21-45 EUR ex VAT at 10kg, see public/shop/shipping-data.js restOfEuropeAt10kg) was deliberately left out of this table: it is a per-country band, not a single carrier tariff, and folding it into one number here would reintroduce an invented default of exactly the kind this table exists to replace.
